Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study employs both DDA (for interactomics/global proteomics) and PRM (for targeted quantification). The primary discovery workflow is AP-MS with LFQ/iBAQ quantification. While the study focuses on ubiquitylation (H2AK119ub1), the mass spectrometry described is for protein abundance (interactomics and PRM) rather than a diGly/ubiquitin-remnant enrichment workflow.

cell_lines: HEK293T and U2OS cells were cultured
DLD1 and HCT116 cells were cultured
scope: we performed a series of affinity purifications followed by mass spectrometry (AP-MS). We immunopurified Flag-tagged USP7 (Flag-USP7) from whole-cell extracts (WCEs)
The resulting immunopurified proteins on beads were directly processed for mass spectrometric analysis.
Immunopurified proteins were subjected to reduction with dithiothreitol and alkylation with iodoacetamide and digested on beads with trypsin

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The study performed both global proteomics on whole cell extracts and interactomics via AP-MS. Following the precedence rules, the affinity-purified material (Flag-USP7 and other baits) used for the interactome analysis defines the sample scope as 'purified protein or complex' (specifically affinity-purified).

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The study used data-dependent acquisition (DDA) on an Orbitrap Lumos and analyzed data using MaxQuant with LFQ and iBAQ options selected.

workflow: Spectra were acquired according to a data-dependent acquisition regime in continuum mode.

differential: t test–based statistics was applied on iBAQ data.

search_parameters: cysteine carbamidomethylation was set as a fixed modification, while STY phosphorylation was set as a variable modification.
